acceptedAnswer.text: Most domestic fridge repairs in Parramatta cost $150 to $450 including parts, plus a call-out fee of about $60 to $200. A door seal is $120 to $300, a compressor $450 to $1,100. You get a fixed quote before we start.

mainEntity.name: How fast can a technician get to Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our technicians are based locally, so travel time to the CBD and nearby suburbs is short. Same-day visits are available where we have a slot, and booking early in the day gives you the best chance.

mainEntity.name: Which fridge brands do you repair in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: We repair most makes, including Samsung, LG, Westinghouse, Fisher & Paykel, Electrolux, Bosch, Hisense and Haier. Have your model number ready when you book. It is on a label inside the fridge.

mainEntity.name: What should I check before I call?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make sure the fridge is plugged in and the door is closing fully, and check for a tripped switch. Note any error code and the brand and model. If the fridge is warm, move meat and dairy to a cooler with ice while you wait.
